description.zh: 专用网络中的实例ID（ECS/负载均衡）
description.en: The ID of an ECS or SLB instance in the VPC.
Specifies whether batch work is required.
The port number that corresponds to the instance.

descriptions.zh:
- 此功能面向开放 API 的用户
- 撤销 API 网关访问您 VPC 实例的权限

> 删除授权可能会影响您线上的API运行，请在删除前确认此授权未被API使用。
descriptions.en:
- This API is intended for API providers.

- Revokes the permissions of API Gateway to access your VPC instance.

> Deleting an authorization affects the associated API. Before you delete the authorization, make sure that it is not used by the API.

example.unifiedCli: aliyun cloudapi remove-vpc-access --vpc-id vpc-uf657qec7lx42paw3qxxx --instance-id i-uf6bzcg1pr4oh5jjmxxx --port 80 --need-batch-work true --api-version 2016-07-14 --region cn-hangzhou
